inputs.lyrics:
[Intro]
Once every twenty-six months,
The sky leaves a window open.

[Verse 1]
Stacked the steel up past the tower lights,
Built you for the longest flight,
First thing I taught you: look up,
Find the red light in the night.

[Pre-Chorus]
Months into days, days into seconds,
Count it down, the window opens

[Chorus]
Here it comes,
The window's open wide.
Here it comes,
We've been waiting all our lives.

[Verse 2]
One more night under the tower,
Seeds in your chest for the ride,
A photo of us, standing outside,
So you know where to look.

[Pre-Chorus]
Twenty-six months down to seconds,
Hold on, here it comes

[Chorus]
Here we go,
The whole world's looking up.
Here we go,
We're leaving the ground.

[Bridge]
Seven months of quiet.
Home's a light the size of a seed.
Then the sun comes up blue
On the red ground under you.

[Pre-Chorus]
Look up, that's us.

[Chorus]
Here we are,
The first light on the ground.
Here we are,
And the window comes back around.

[Outro]
See you in twenty-six months.
